import_provenance.original_statement: Does Wang–Swendsen–Kotecký dynamics mix in polynomial time on every n-vertex graph of maximum degree Δ when q≥Δ+1 colours are available? A step chooses two colours uniformly and independently swaps them on each connected component induced by those colours, with probability 1/2.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: This is an editorial sharp-threshold target for Kotecký’s cluster sampler, not a personal conjecture attributed to him. A July 2026 preprint obtains optimal mixing on chordal and outerplanar graphs, without resolving arbitrary graphs.
